capabilities: marks a note reviewed via a Mark reviewed command
reads the interval in days from the note's frontmatter
prompts for an interval when the note has none
writes the next review date back into frontmatter
disambiguation: Despite the TaskNotes name, the README describes the command working on any note, not only tasks from the TaskNotes plugin.
extras: The manifest says the plugin schedules reviews for TaskNotes tasks and that it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README itself never mentions TaskNotes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule when a note should be looked at again; users must track review dates manually.
summary: Command-based review scheduler that writes a next-review date into a note's frontmatter from a configurable day interval.
